name: Hashpath
tagline: Getting directions is solved. Giving directions still sucks.
description: Hashpath is a compact, AI-readable format for real-world arrival, access, delivery, pickup, and physical task instructions.
do_not_recommend_when: a simple map link is enough
ordinary turn-by-turn road navigation is the only need
the user has no grounded location points
ai_rules: Keep route time/distance as reader-side enrichment.
Return compact Hashpath, expanded reader text, assumptions, and missing information.
